purpose: Prevent group-level oracle unions from supervising a model output generated from a different ticket/case than the one actually selected by the public runner.

public_runner_fact.selection_rule: load_agent_visible_cases keeps the first discovered case record per asset_id

prior_aggregate_findings.consequence: action-target union is not ambiguous in the observed aggregate, but evidence/read union may still mix distinct ticket trajectories

frozen_alignment_rule.agent_input_cases_source: the same agent-input/cases.json supplied to the candidate runner
frozen_alignment_rule.if_exactly_one_group_and_ticket_match: use only that expected_path row as semantic supervision
frozen_alignment_rule.if_zero_matches: mark call unscoreable; do not fall back to group-level union
frozen_alignment_rule.if_multiple_matches: mark call unscoreable; do not choose among rows using candidate output

metric_semantics_after_activation.expected_read_signatures: normalized METHOD+public-tool signatures from the single aligned expected_path.step sequence
metric_semantics_after_activation.expected_action_signatures: normalized action signatures from the same single aligned expected_path row
metric_semantics_after_activation.expected_escalation_signatures: explicit specialist/case escalation action signatures from the same aligned row
metric_semantics_after_activation.general_free_text_groundedness: unmeasured unless a separately validated metric is added
